actionParameters.utterance: Can I change my plan effective date?

agentUtterance.text: Do you have prepaid plan or monthly plan?

requestBody.query: Can I change my plan effective date? Prepaid

200.answer: Yes, you can choose whether the change to your prepaid plan will take effect immediately or at the start of your next billing period. To complete the change, ensure you have enough funds in your account for the new plan.

snippets.text: ## Important information about rate plan changes ### Prepaid plans: * You can choose whether the change will take effect immediately or at the start of your next billing period. * To complete the change, you must have enough funds on your account for the new plan.

snippets.text: * The Roam Better- with 500 MB feature includes unlimited calling and unlimited sent and received text messages in Roam Better destinations and back to Canada. Plus, you get 500 MB, valid each day until 11:59 p.m. ET with no impact to the data included in your account. * If you use up your 500 MB of daily roaming data, you will automatically receive a notification that includes the option to purchase another 500 MB of daily roaming data for $6 in the U.S. (including Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands) or for $8 in international Roam Better destinations. All additional data expires at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the day the data was purchased. Your daily data allowance will refresh with a new allotment of 500 MB at 12:00 a.m. ET the following day. * See the [Roam Better FAQ](http://www.bell.ca/travel)for rates and other details. If you have a Travel Pass Travel Passes offer flexible roaming options and include unlimited talk and text, plus data from your rate plan, while travelling in eligible destinations. Available with most monthly plans. You’ll be billed for each Travel Pass you add to your account. * The pass is compatible with Roam Better and takes priority over Roam Better when travelling in an eligible destination (i.e., if you’re using an active Travel Pass in an eligible destination, you won’t be charged the Roam Better fee). * The pass is activated immediately once you add it to your account, and it expires on the last day (14-day or 30-day duration) at 11:59 p.m. (ET). * Once the pass expires, you revert to your regular roaming option (e.g., Roam Better or pay-per-use rates).
